overview.description: The Northern Trust Morningstar Emerging Markets Factor Tilt ETF (TLTE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of equities from emerging market countries. The index underweights large-cap and growth stocks in favor of small-cap and value stocks. TLTE was launched on Sep 28, 2012 and is issued by Northern Trust.
